checks.name: student selection appends immediately, modal search persists after reopening and clearing restores results
second Cafe tab follows undo/redo; five starred positions and per-Cafe values stay independent
stage count follows undo/redo; phase 2 exposes seven rules and phase 3 exposes three
student recommendation replaces phase 2 with recommended nodes followed by remaining defaults; undo restores custom order
priority keyboard preview does not persist; Escape cancels it; committed reorder and undo restore exact labels
invalid crafting count remains local and Undo returns to the saved value
preset grid follows stored dimensions; five attributes; order mode hides both grids without changing them
lesson preference visibility follows toggle and Undo; disabling retains ordered student names
empty sweep count remains local; student choice adds all drop stages once at count three and Undo restores empty plan
unknown plan and count tokens remain visible; explicit row deletion or count replacement is undoable
exploration retains saved chapters and missions outside current choices and preserves unknown raw rows; deletion can be undone
